summary: In this video, Skyasterix tackles the Season 9 Crown Contest against the Fire Guardian boss. He emphasizes that gearing for high Resistance and synchronizing ultimate skill timings are mandatory to prevent heroes from being interrupted or debuffed. After struggling with control effects on a Dauntless Lightning comp and achieving moderate success with Radiance, he builds an optimized Poison squad that surpasses 3.18 billion damage.

Radiance setup hitting approximately 1.73 billion damage; demands strict ultimate skill synchronization to avoid boss interrupts.

meta_changes: Fire Guardian boss encounters heavily penalize teams lacking sufficient gear Resistance and strict skill timing synchronization.
tips: Equip Resistance-primary armor or Resistance secondary stats on damage dealers and supports to prevent Fire Guardian debuffs and control effects.
Carefully calibrate hero First Cast and Recast skill timings down to tenths of a second to prevent ultimate desynchronization.
Prioritize unlocking high-tier hero talents (such as Lothair's Stage 6 talent) before committing high-score Crown Contest attempts.
